timeout.interpretation: A graphics command buffer exceeded the AMD macOS GPU watchdog after 6.34 seconds. This is distinct from the earlier unsatisfied cross-queue timeline wait; exact draw/dispatch attribution was unavailable because bounded work tracing was not armed.

v12FixStillValidated.note: The first v12 timeout appeared only after shader compilation/menu transition and contained no unsatisfied event on the failing buffer.

nextDiagnostic.purpose: Capture the exact draw/dispatch sequence in a reproducing watchdog before changing command-buffer segmentation or shaders.
